messages:
julia_sales: NimbusCorp wants to flip signer order on OF-4582, route countersign to their procurement. Can legal advise on assignment carveout? cc @alex_legal @mike_procurement

alex_legal: We can offer narrow M&A assignment carveout but must preserve data/KMS obligations and liability caps.

mike_procurement: They also requested net45 and a vendor escrow clause in Appendix B. That affects billing and AR.

emma_se: POC ask: 30-day eval with dedicated pool (2x vGPU) for load tests. That impacts SLA.

sanjay_se: Ops delta for reserved capacity ~+$12k for 4 weeks. Need finance approval.

olivia_finance: Net45 ok only with 50% deposit for dedicated capacity.

devops_bot: Provisioning queued: workspace `nimbus-eval`. ETA 48h after legal + payment cleared.

customer_liaison: Customer expects kickoff next week. Can legal fast-track?

alex_legal: Ill redline in 2 hours. Will keep carveout narrow and require notice + assignee obligations.

julia_sales: Plan: Alex redlines -> Olivia confirms deposit -> I coordinate signature flow & get NDA -> Devops provisions sandbox.

alex_legal: Uploaded redline: https://files.redwood/legal/redlines/OF-4582-assignment-draft.docx
